points.claim: The queen was unarmed and embraced him when he struck.
points.support: I stood at the door. She had no blade, no guard, no dragon in the room. He came as a friend and killed her as a friend. That is the whole of it.
No council. No chains. No demand that she step down before the army. A soldier who thinks his commander wrong says so, or he leaves. He does not put a knife in her.

points.claim: What she said she would do had not been done.
points.support: The city burned; that was done. The rest was words. He killed her for words about cities she had not yet reached.
